name: FLA_PAYMENT_ITEMS
description: FLA_PAYMENT_ITEMS contains payment items data generated for the lease payments.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: PAYMENT_ITEM_ID. It is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It references the primary key of the FLA_LEASES_ALL table.

columns.name: LEASE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Lease detail identifier. It is referenced from FLA_LEASE_DETAILS table.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment number. Payment Item is part of this Payment Header.

columns.name: PAYMENT_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Payment line number. Payment Item is part of this Payment Line.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the lease as captured in FLA_LEASE_DETAILS.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier.  It is used to send the information to Payables during the payment process.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_ID
columns.description: Supplier site identifier. It is used to send the information to Payables during the payment process.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Payment item currency code. This is based on the Payment currency code.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated payment item amount in the payment currency.

columns.name: ACTUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment item amount in the payment currency.

columns.name: ASSESSABLE_VALUE
columns.description: User-enterable amount to be used as taxable basis.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Due date of the payment item as per the schedule in Payment Lines.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Beginning date of the payment item.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Ending date of the payment item. This is based on the Payment Line.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period in which payment item falls in.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the payment item is transferred for accounting.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the payment item is created because of an adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the payment item adjustment is made.

columns.name: REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the payment item is created because of a reversal of generated payment items.

columns.name: READ_IN_DRAFT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment item was considered for generation in the draft lease.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ITEM_FOR_STUB_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment item was generated for a stub payment line.

columns.name: INVOICE_NUM
columns.description: Stores the invoice number generated and sent to Payables for the payment item.

columns.name: INVOICE_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Stores the invoice line number generated and sent to Payables for the payment item.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_FUNC_CURR_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated payment item amount in the functional currency.

columns.name: ACTUAL_FUNC_CURR_AMOUNT
columns.description: Actual payment item amount in the functional currency

columns.name: FUNC_CURR_CONV_RATE
columns.description: Rate used to calculate the functional currency amount.

columns.name: FUNC_CURR_CONV_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Exchange rate type for foreign currency amounts.

columns.name: FUNC_CURR_CONV_DATE
columns.description: Date exchange rate is effective from. Usually the payment due date.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if the payment item is approved for Payables invoice creation.

columns.name: APPROVAL_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the approval for the payment item was done.

columns.name: APPROVED_BY
columns.description: User ID who has done the approval of the payment item.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments or details provided by the user who has approved or exported the payment item

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the payment item export status to Oracle Payables. Various statuses can be PENDING, INPROGRESS, HOLD, INTERFACED, ABANDONED.

columns.name: INTERFACE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the payment item status was updated

columns.name: INVOICE_CREATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of Payables Invoice, whether the Invoice was generated successfully. For future use.

columns.name: PARENT_PAYMENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: This identifies the parent payment item for this payment item.

columns.name: EXPORT_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Payables Invoice grouping purpose. For future use.

columns.name: OPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Option flag which indicates if the payment items are generated for an option or not.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_SET_ID
columns.description: Distribution set identifier. It is passed into Payables.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment term identifier for calculation of due date.

columns.name: PRIMARY_INTENDED_USE
columns.description: Tax Driver: The purpose for which a product may be used. The actual use is stored at the distribution level.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax classification code for payment term.

columns.name: TAX_INCLUDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether tax is included or not.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Identifies the taxable nature of a noninventory based item for tax determination or tax reporting.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FISCAL_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Tax Driver: Product fiscal classification

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.description: Tax Driver: Type of product. Possible values are Goods and Services. This value defaults from Inventory Item attributes or is entered by the user.

columns.name: REPORT_FROM_INCEPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the streams is generated from the inception of the lease or not.

columns.name: TRX_BUSINESS_CATEGORY
columns.description: Tax Driver: Transactions category assigned by user.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISCAL_CLASS
columns.description: Tax Driver: Fiscal Classification.

columns.name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Withholding tax group identifier.

columns.name: INTERCOMPANY_FLAG
columns.description: Intercompany flag with possible values as Y or N. Mainly used for reporting purposes

columns.name: APPROVAL_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch identifier of the batch which was picked and processed for invoice & accounting approval.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ELIGIBILITY_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the payment item export status to Oracle Payables. Various statuses can be YES, NO or HOLD. This would be a user entered option.

columns.name: CHARGE_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Account identifier. Code Combination of the primary ledger charge account stored on the payment. Charge account will be sent to Oracle Payables during invoice creation.

columns.name: LIABILITY_ACCOUNT_CCID
columns.description: Account identifier. Code Combination of the primary ledger liability account stored on the payment. Liability account will be sent to Oracle Payables during invoice creation.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_INVOICE_REF_NUMBER
columns.description: Supplier number reference for the invoice.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Contingent amount captured for the payment increase per payment period.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment increase agreement number referenced from the FLA_INCREMENT_HEADERS table.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the payment increase assessment is performed.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INCREASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the payment is generated for a payment increase line.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_INCREASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the payment is generated for cumulative increase amount of payment increase line.

columns.name: MANUAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the manual action that has happened on the payment item before its approval. Possible values can be Modified or Manually Created.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Payment type. Values are derived from ORA_FLA_PAYMENT_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PURPOSE_CODE
columns.description: Payment purpose. Values are derived from ORA_FLA_PAYMENT_PURPOSE lookup.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Asset number which is associated to the payment.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Payment template identifier. References the payment template from which the payment is created.

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_USER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the user responsible for the update to the payment item amount.

columns.name: REVENUE_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the method for spread of generated revenue, valid values are lease revenue and non lease revenue.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of schedule, valid values are PAYMENT and BILLING.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer identifier for the billing.

columns.name: BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Ship to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type identifier to be sent to Receivables.

columns.name: AR_INVOICE_ID
columns.description: Invoice identifier of the Receivables invoice.

columns.name: AR_INVOICE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Invoice line identifier of the Receivables invoice line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Classification used by a tax authority to categorize a document associated with a transaction for a tax.

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Deploying company's Tax Registration number

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Bill-to Customer Tax Registration Number

columns.name: REFERENCE_PAYMENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Stores the reference payment item identifier for which the credit memo is being generated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ITEM_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of payment item. Values can be REGULAR, RECOVERABLE and NONRECOVERABLE.

columns.name: TAX_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Reference of the tax transaction identifier.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TAX_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment tax line number. This is generated by system using a document sequence.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
